name: aggregate-groupby-includes-null
$comment: Grouped aggregate over an indexed optional string with absent values: rows without the field form one SQL NULL group (GROUP BY groups NULLs together), which sorts last under ORDER BY k (Postgres ASC NULLS LAST) and surfaces as key null — mirroring the distinct terminal's include-null semantics. Groups: a={c}=3, x={a,e}=1+5=6, null={b,d}=2+4=6.
